Subject: HIPAA readiness questionnaire + BAA request

Hi Grace,

Thanks for the demo last week — our team was impressed with Redwood's latency/throughput profile. As we discussed on the call, Green Valley Health needs a completed HIPAA readiness questionnaire and an initial BAA to start procurement. Attached is our standard questionnaire (lightly customized). Please return answers and a draft BAA by end of week if possible; procurement wants this packaged for our legal review.

Key asks in the questionnaire: data residency for PHI, encryption at-rest/key management, access controls and audit logging, SOC 2 scope, and incident response timelines. We also included a simple dataflow mapping page — we need confirmation you can support a hybrid model where some inference runs in our VPC.

Attachments: GVH_HIPAA_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx

Thanks,
Jillian Park

Green Valley Health

Hi Jillian —

Appreciate the packet and the clear asks. We're glad Green Valley found the demo useful. We're committing to a turnaround by EOW with two deliverables: (1) a completed questionnaire with inline clarifications where your items need more context, and (2) a first-pass BAA tailored to the deployment model you described (hosted + VPC private connectors).

Quick clarifications to help our answers:
- For the dataflow mapping, can you confirm whether PHI is sent to Redwood's hosted endpoints, or only to Dedicated/Private instances in your VPC? Hybrid patterns change a few controls we will call out.
- For KMS: do you require customer-managed keys (CMK) in your environment or is provider-managed KMS acceptable for the hosted portions?

I'll coordinate internally and send the package by Friday COB. Looping in Rishi (security) and Marissa (customer success/legal ops) to prepare the docs.

Best,

From: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai

Cc: 
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 09:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: HIPAA readiness questionnaire + BAA request

Grace / Marissa —

I've started filling the questionnaire. Notes below on items that typically require a short explanation vs. supporting evidence:

1) Data residency / hybrid flow: Redwood supports three modes: hosted (redwood-managed endpoints), Dedicated reserved pools (customer tenancy on shared infra), and Private (VPC/on-prem). For Green Valley's hybrid ask we should mark: PHI is only routed to Private or Dedicated submitted under customer network peering; hosted endpoints will be used only for non-PHI metadata unless GVH explicitly consents with CMK.

2) Encryption & KMS: We support provider-managed KMS for hosted. We can do CMK via AWS KMS or HSM integrations in Private deployments. For the questionnaire, recommend we flag: "customer-managed keys available for private deployments; provider-managed for hosted with standard AES-256."

3) Audit logging & access controls: We have token-level tracing in Console and immutable audit logs for Dedicated/Private with configurable retention. We'll attach our audit log retention policy excerpt.

4) SOC 2: Redwood has SOC 2 Type II in scope for the inference service; mention SOC 2 report available under NDA.

5) Incident response: 1-hour P1 acknowledgment SLA for Dedicated customers (Enterprise tier), 4-hour acknowledgment for hosted. For PHI breach handling we'll reference our escalation playbook and that we will coordinate with GVH incident response.

I'll put answers in the spreadsheet and draft the BAA changes (start from our standard doc). Marissa — can you drop the BAA draft into Drive and add the clause we normally use for customer-controlled KMS and for on-prem inference?

-Rishi
Principal Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai; grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
Cc:

Thanks Rishi — I uploaded a BAA draft and a short evidence pack to the GVH folder (see links). A few items to note for Jillian:
- We will mark encryption at-rest as AES-256 and list KMS integrations (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, customer-supplied HSM via Private).
- For logging: include sample audit log schema and TTL options (30/90/365 days).
- For the hybrid flow language: propose the line "Redwood will only process PHI on customer-controlled infrastructure (Dedicated/Private) unless customer explicitly authorizes processing on Redwood-hosted endpoints using customer-managed encryption keys."

I drafted a light redline to the BAA to cover CMK, subprocessor disclosure cadence (30 days notice + right to object), and a standard liability clause cap. Please review before I send to Jillian.

Attachments in Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cGVH-hipaa
BAA Draft: BAA_Draft_Redwood_v1.docx

-Marissa Cole

Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 16:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: HIPAA readiness questionnaire + BAA request

Hi Jillian —

Attached is our completed questionnaire (answers in-line) and a first-pass BAA tailored to the hybrid deployment you described. Highlights:

- Dataflow: Confirmed support for hybrid: PHI processing can be restricted to your Private/VPC deployment or Dedicated reserved pools. We will not process PHI on Redwood-hosted endpoints unless GVH signs off on CMK usage for hosted. See page 2 of the questionnaire for our recommended phrasing.
- Encryption: AES-256 at rest; TLS1.2+ in transit. CMK supported for Private deployments and for hosted when configured via Bring-Your-Own-Key (BYOK) with AWS KMS/GCP KMS; HSM options available for on-prem.
- Audit logs & retention: Immutable audit trail available for Dedicated/Private with configurable retention (30/90/365 days). Console exposes token-level tracing for customer investigations.
- SOC 2: report available under NDA; we'll provide SOC 2 Type II summary and control IDs mapping on request.
- Incident response: For customers on our enterprise agreement, we provide 1-hour P1 acknowledgement and escalation into our incident command.

Attachments: GVH_HIPAA_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx (completed), Redwood_Dataflow_Diagram_v2.pdf, BAA_Draft_Redwood_v1.docx

Next steps: please confirm whether GVH requires BYOK for hosted endpoints or if Dedicated/Private-only is acceptable. If BYOK is required for hosted, we'll add the BYOK annex to the BAA and propose a short technical onboarding window. Also let us know if legal wants different liability language; Marissa can coordinate redlines.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call tomorrow to go through any questions.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
